About The Clinic

Fifteen years of trusted cardiac care in Nasr City

Founded in 2009, Cairo Heart Center began as a small consultation practice and has grown into one of the most respected private cardiology clinics in Cairo.

Today, our team of 8 specialists sees over 12,000+ patients each year — combining international standards of care with the personal touch of a neighborhood clinic.

Excellence

Internationally trained specialists using current clinical protocols.

Transparency

Clear fees, transparent deposit model, ETA e-receipts on every payment.

Continuity

Every patient sees the same consultant for follow-up visits and care.

Accessibility

WhatsApp-first communication, Fawry and Vodafone Cash payment options.
